claude_proposed_widenings.name: RepeatSaveSpec.cadence: elapsed_days
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Befuddlement's repeat save fires every 30 days — a calendar-time cadence. RepeatSaveSpec.cadence only supports 'end_of_target_turn' and 'on_target_takes_damage'. A new variant is needed: { kind: 'elapsed_days', days: number }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: At the end of every 30 days, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on a success.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom: restrict_action_set (standalone, target-applied)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell's on-fail effect prevents the target from casting spells or taking the Magic action. 'restrict_action_set' exists in v4 TAXONOMY §9 but is only surfaced in types.ts as ActionRestriction nested inside grant_extra_action (caster-side). A standalone EffectAtom is needed that restricts specified action kinds on the target creature for the duration of a persistent effect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the target takes 10d12 Psychic damage and can't cast spells or take the Magic action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Duration.permanent.endsOn: named_spell_cast_on_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The persistent restriction ends if Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish is cast on the target. The current permanent.endsOn union only supports 'dispel' | 'damage'. Encoding 'ended by a specific spell cast on target' requires a new endsOn variant (or a closed list of spell IDs).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The effect can also be ended by the Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish spell.
